_comment: List prices per million tokens, USD, pinned on the date given. Fill the entry for the model chosen in preflight before the first run; collect-usage.mjs leaves worker_usd_estimate null when the model is missing here. Tokens come from GET /v1/agents/{id}/usage and are measured; USD is always an estimate.

grok-4.7.note: xAI list price for prompts under 200k tokens. At or above 200k the published rates double. Cursor may bill this model on a different schedule; the USD figure is an estimate, not an invoice.
